findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: screen_entity, run_due_diligence, screen_cross_border_payment, create_travel_rule_packet, create_watchlist_monitor, cancel_watchlist_monitor · Private data: screen_entity, screen_wallet, search_mauritius_registry, run_due_diligence, screen_cross_border_payment, create_travel_rule_packet, verify_travel_rule_packet, create_watchlist_monitor, check_watchlist_monitors, cancel_watchlist_monitor, verify_agent_identity · Public sink: create_watchlist_monitor, check_watchlist_monitors, cancel_watchlist_monitor · Destructive: run_due_diligence, verify_agent_identity.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: screen_entity, run_due_diligence, screen_cross_border_payment, create_travel_rule_packet, create_watchlist_monitor, cancel_watchlist_monitor · Private data: screen_entity, screen_wallet, search_mauritius_registry, run_due_diligence, screen_cross_border_payment, create_travel_rule_packet, verify_travel_rule_packet, create_watchlist_monitor, check_watchlist_monitors, cancel_watchlist_monitor, verify_agent_identity · Public sink: create_watchlist_monitor, check_watchlist_monitors, cancel_watchlist_monitor · Destructive: run_due_diligence, verify_agent_identity

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
